title: Pop-up title lookup order
detail: Pop-up titles are found by a data attribute, then the existing heading class, then the first h1 to h6.
why: That class is the only pop-up title class on staging today.
question: Any other pop-up whose title becomes a paragraph needs the attribute added in the Designer; is that fine?

title: Room grid and quiz title classes
detail: Room grid and quiz titles are found by their existing heading classes, falling back to h2 or h3.
why: Those are the classes the cards and panels carry now.
question: Keep those classes when the tags change?

title: Heading check matches by section
detail: Rows match by sheet section as well as text; the page section is learned from rows with unique text.
why: Sheet section names are free text, not class names.
question: OK as the matching rule?

title: What counts as a shared part
detail: Shared parts are the footer links, booking and newsletter band, offers slider and FAQ; a missing part counts as a difference.
why: These are the shared parts the spec names.
question: Should a page that simply lacks a part (the 404, four dining venues without the offers slider) count as a difference?

title: Template rows and paragraph rows
detail: Template rows match on the example text; rows proposed as p are left out of the proposed heading counts.
why: The example is the page the tab checks.
question: Fine?

title: Modal title attribute not in table
detail: The new title attribute is described in prose but is not a row of the attribute table.

title: Heading check copies crawl code
detail: The page loader copies the copy-check worker pool and re-implements the where-used crawl.

title: Crawl cap silent, exit code always 0
detail: The crawl stops at 400 pages without a warning and the command exits 0 whatever the result.
